data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word 'tapeinos' meaning 'low, humble'. In Christianity, humility is a virtue emphasized in the teachings of Jesus and the New Testament, reflecting a selfless attitude and acknowledgement of God's supremacy. The name Humble carries the meaning “Humble: meek, lowly” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Humble usually hope their child will grow to embody humble: meek, lowly and live with faith, good character and purpose.
